title: Parkio Daily for July 29, 2026
teaser: Zootopia pre-show debuts at Animal Kingdom; new Napoleon wrasse swims into The Seas; Indiana Jones closes Sept 8 at Disneyland.

breaking.title: Zootopia ride adds Mayor Winddancer pre-show at Animal Kingdom
breaking.body: The Zootopia: Better Zoogether attraction now features a new pre-show with Mayor Brian Winddancer, voiced by Patrick Warburton, from Zootopia 2. The addition went live today at Disney's Animal Kingdom.

parkioInsight.text: Zootopia typically draws heavier crowds early afternoon. Riding before 11am or after 5pm tends to keep waits manageable, usually under 30 minutes.

breaking.title: Citywide water outage hits Anaheim, affecting Disneyland operations
breaking.body: A municipal water failure in Anaheim is causing operational disruptions at Disneyland today. The scope of the outage and its impact on attractions and services is still unfolding.

parkioInsight.text: Restroom and dining service may be limited throughout the park today. Check the Disneyland app for real-time closures before committing to long waits or meal reservations.

bignews.title: Indiana Jones Adventure closing September 8 for refurbishment
bignews.body: Disneyland's iconic Indiana Jones Adventure: Temple of the Forbidden Eye will shut down starting September 8 for an extended refurbishment. No reopening date has been announced.

parkioInsight.text: If Indiana Jones is a must-do, visit before early September. Late August typically sees lighter crowds ahead of Labor Day weekend.

bignews.title: Animal Kingdom Lodge refurbishments starting next month
bignews.body: Walt Disney World has added multiple refurbishment projects at both Jambo House and Kidani Village at Animal Kingdom Lodge. Work begins in August and runs through winter 2027.

parkioInsight.text: Construction noise and limited amenities are likely at Animal Kingdom Lodge starting mid-August. Consider booking elsewhere if you're prioritizing a quiet resort experience.

bignews.title: New Napoleon wrasse joins The Seas aquarium at EPCOT
bignews.body: EPCOT's 5.7-million-gallon SeaBase aquarium has welcomed Toa, a large and colorful Napoleon wrasse. The fish is now visible to guests visiting The Seas with Nemo & Friends.

parkioInsight.text: The Seas pavilion usually has short waits throughout the day. Worth a stop mid-afternoon when other EPCOT attractions are busier.

topstories.title: Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party food lineup revealed
topstories.body: Magic Kingdom has unveiled the full menu for this year's Halloween party running August 7 through October 31. The lineup includes themed treats and seasonal dishes available only during event nights.

parkioInsight.text: Party-exclusive snacks tend to sell out by 9pm on peak nights. Hitting Main Street or Liberty Square food carts early in the event usually secures the full selection.

topstories.title: New UK Pavilion plaid collection arrives at EPCOT
topstories.body: A plaid-themed merchandise line featuring a Spirit Jersey, scarf, and ear headband is now available at the Sportsman's Shoppe in the United Kingdom Pavilion at EPCOT.

parkioInsight.text: Limited merchandise tends to move fast at World Showcase shops. Morning shoppers before 11am usually find the best inventory and shorter checkout lines.

topstories.title: DVC members can claim exclusive donut in Disney Springs
topstories.body: Disney Vacation Club members have access to a free specialty donut at a Disney Springs location for a limited time. The offer is exclusive to DVC cardholders.

parkioInsight.text: Disney Springs bakeries typically restock mid-morning. Claiming the DVC donut before noon likely ensures availability and avoids late-day sellouts.

topstories.title: Mickey's of Glendale returns to D23 with new Imagineering collection
topstories.body: The fan-favorite Mickey's of Glendale booth will be back at D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event in August, offering exclusive Walt Disney Imagineering merchandise.

parkioInsight.text: D23 merchandise lines tend to form before the show floor opens. Arriving at the convention center early on booth-launch days usually improves your odds of snagging limited items.

topstories.title: Southwest offering $59 flights to Orlando for limited time
topstories.body: Southwest Airlines has launched a sale with flights to Orlando starting at $59 for select dates. The promotional fares are available for a limited booking window.

parkioInsight.text: Fare sales often expire within 48 hours or when inventory runs out. Booking today and targeting off-peak travel dates usually locks in the lowest prices.

topstories.title: RunDisney announces new virtual Halloween event
topstories.body: A spooky-themed virtual runDisney event has been revealed, allowing participants to complete challenges from home and earn themed medals and rewards.

parkioInsight.text: Virtual race registrations typically fill fastest in the first 24 hours. Signing up today often guarantees your spot and first access to exclusive merchandise bundles.

icymi.title: Disney Worldbuilders documentary coming to Disney+ in August
icymi.body: A new behind-the-scenes series exploring the creation of Disney park lands and attractions will debut on Disney+ next month, featuring Imagineering teams and their design process.

icymi.title: Orlando International Airport climbs to top 10 busiest in US
icymi.body: MCO has moved up in national airport rankings, with passenger volume continuing to grow even as travel demand softens at other major hubs.

icymi.title: Disney Wish cruise ship returned to port for medical emergency
icymi.body: The Disney Wish turned back within hours of departure on Monday to handle a guest medical situation, delaying the sailing schedule temporarily.

spotlight.title: Magic Kingdom crowd calendar: best and worst days through Christmas
spotlight.body: A detailed breakdown of crowd patterns from August through December shows wide variation in park capacity at Magic Kingdom. The guide highlights low-traffic windows during Halloween and Christmas seasons and flags peak days to avoid.

parkioInsight.text: Mid-week visits in late September and early November typically see the lightest crowds before holiday peaks. Rope-dropping Tomorrowland or Fantasyland on those days often yields walk-on windows for headliners.
